provenance.asset_description: A gameplay screenshot of Starfinder Invasion's Edge on Foundry Virtual Tabletop. The screenshot is of the inside of a transport vehicle and the surrounding area. Five character icons are inside the transport vehicle and five character icons are on the outside of the vehicle. It appears as if the character outside are surrounding and attempting to board the vehicle.
